purpose: Freeze dividend payout capacity, coverage, retention and sustainability semantics before curriculum intake or return-outcome research.

ownership.owns: Fundamental/accounting capacity to sustain shareholder cash dividends through time.
doesNotOwn: raw earnings/CFO/FCF/balance-sheet primitives already owned by D07 sibling modules

payoutComponents.ordinaryCashDividendFromCurrentOrRetaine: Cash distribution economically funded from earnings/retained earnings and classified separately by declared source when disclosed.
payoutComponents.cashDistributionFromLegalOrCapitalReserv: Separate reserve-funded cash distribution; never silently counted as current-earnings payout.
payoutComponents.stockDividendFromEarnings: Capitalization/share distribution. Not a cash outflow and excluded from cash-coverage ratios.
payoutComponents.stockDividendFromReserve: Capitalization/share distribution from reserve. Excluded from cash-coverage ratios.
payoutComponents.specialCashDividend: Only tagged SPECIAL when issuer/source explicitly identifies one-off/special nature or a frozen source rule proves it; size alone cannot infer special.
payoutComponents.buybackOrCashCapitalReduction: Companion shareholder-payout mechanisms owned outside this module; may be consumed as context but not merged into dividend coverage without separate source/PIT contract.

earningsCashPayoutRatio.formula: ordinary cash dividends declared for earnings period / net income attributable to owners of parent for the same compatible earnings period
guards: denominator must be positive and safely away from zero
period basis and consolidated scope must match
near-zero/negative denominator => ratio UNKNOWN; retain transition state and raw amounts

earningsDividendCoverage.formula: net income attributable to owners of parent / ordinary cash dividends declared for same earnings period
guards: positive compatible numerator and positive dividend denominator required

cashSettlementCoverage.formula: operating cash flow for cash-flow period / cash dividends actually paid during the same cash-flow period
cashSettlementCoverage.meaning: Liquidity/funding coverage, not declaration-policy payout ratio.

fcfDividendCoverage.formula: frozen PIT-safe free cash flow / cash dividends actually paid in aligned period
fcfDividendCoverage.rule: Remain UNKNOWN until D07-05 freezes a replayable FCF/CapEx definition.

cashRetentionRatio.meaning: Accounting/economic cash retention relative to current earnings; not proof of productive reinvestment.

perSharePayoutApproximation.reason: Share-count, diluted/basic EPS and corporate-action timing can make per-share arithmetic diverge from total-amount payout.

mandatoryDimensions: ordinary payout history and omission/cut behavior
distribution source: earnings vs retained earnings vs reserve

payoutStability.sequenceIdentity: distribution earnings period + decision level + ordinary/special classification
payoutStability.rule: Quarterly/semiannual/annual distributions must not be compared as if frequencies were identical; special distributions are excluded from ordinary stability series.

taiwanDecisionClocks.financialStatementKnownAt: MOPS financial report publication/filing timestamp for the compatible earnings/cash-flow denominator.
taiwanDecisionClocks.boardProposalKnownAt: Earliest MOPS/issuer filing timestamp showing board-approved proposed distribution.
taiwanDecisionClocks.finalDistributionDecisionKnownAt: Depends on legal/charter decision level. Board decision can be final for qualifying cash distributions where law/articles allow; otherwise shareholder-meeting approval is the finality event.
taiwanDecisionClocks.exDate: Exchange/MOPS ex-right/ex-dividend effective event; D11-owned event mechanics.
taiwanDecisionClocks.paymentDate: Cash settlement/payment date; used for cash-settlement coverage period alignment, not as the initial policy knownAt.
taiwanDecisionClocks.revisionRule: Every proposal/approval/change/correction is append-only; later final values cannot overwrite earlier decision-time state.

legalAndAccountingGuards.quarterlyOrSemiannual: Taiwan Company Act Article 228-1 permits articles to provide quarterly/semiannual distributions; public companies use CPA audited/reviewed statements and cash distribution is board-resolved under the specified mechanism.
legalAndAccountingGuards.stockDividend: Stock distribution follows share-issuance/corporate-action rules and is not cash payout coverage.
legalAndAccountingGuards.capitalReserveCash: Company Act Article 241 permits certain legal/capital reserve distributions under conditions; classify separately from earnings-funded ordinary dividend.
legalAndAccountingGuards.parentVsConsolidated: Legal distributable capacity is not identical to consolidated economic earnings. Preserve parent legal reserve/retained-earnings constraints separately from consolidated parent-attributable net income.
legalAndAccountingGuards.financialInstitutions: Generic payout ratios may be descriptive, but sustainability requires regulatory capital/solvency constraints from the financial-institution specialist lane; otherwise sustainability=UNKNOWN.

antiDoubleCount.D07_02: Consumes net income/EPS but does not duplicate the raw earnings factor as a second vote.
antiDoubleCount.D07_05: Consumes CFO/FCF coverage; cash-flow quality remains owned by D07-05.
antiDoubleCount.D07_06: Consumes liquidity/leverage context; balance-sheet quality remains D07-06.
antiDoubleCount.D08: Dividend yield and valuation are valuation context; payout sustainability is not a valuation multiple.
antiDoubleCount.D11: Ex-date/payment/event reaction mechanics are D11; D07 uses clocks only for PIT alignment.
antiDoubleCount.D21: Board policy/process and governance quality are D21; D07 measures accounting/economic capacity to sustain payouts.
antiDoubleCount.sharedEventRule: One canonical dividend decision/event receipt may feed multiple child views but cannot create independent duplicated votes.

evidenceRole.strategyEvidence: Not until prospective/OOS tests show incremental information beyond profitability, cash flow, leverage, valuation, sector and regime.
